# Bond (security master): bond (BND)

A listed bond: terms, price, yield, spreads and analytics. One row per bond (security master) per business date, keyed by ISIN. Read by the **market-data** pack's connector `market-store` (table `<root>/market/bond/`). Delivered **daily**, 60 business days (2026-07-08 to 2026-09-30): the first day's file is a **full snapshot** (32 records); each later day's file holds only the records new or changed that day (32–32 a day). Drishti applies a day's file by key over the day before: a record absent from a day's file keeps its previous version, and nothing is ever deleted (an end is a changed status). 1,920 rows in all.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `data/testdata/market-data/bond/` + `changes-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz`, `snapshot-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line, gzip-compressed (`.jsonl.gz`) |
| Key field | `ISIN` |
| Date field | none in the record: the business date is the file's date (`snapshot-` or `changes-YYYY-MM-DD`), which becomes the lake's partition `business_date` |
| Promoted columns | none (the whole record is kept as `doc`) |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | a full snapshot on the first day, then only the changed records |

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ISIN` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | pattern `^BND-` | `"BND-US0UST030079"` |
| `ISIN_CODE` | string | required | The bond's 12-character ISIN (without the BND- prefix of the record id). | — | `"US0UST030079"` |
| `ISSUER_NAME` | string | required | The issuer's legal name. | — | `"United States Treasury"` |
| `COUPON` | number | required | The annual coupon rate, as a fraction (0.0579 is 5.79%). | unit: fraction | `0.0382` |
| `MATURITY` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The bond's maturity date. | — | `"2031-02-15"` |
| `PRICE` | number | required | The bond's price per 100 of face value, in the bond's currency (TERMS.CURRENCY). | unit: per 100 face | `97.578` |
| `YIELD` | number | required | The yield to maturity, as a fraction (0.071 is 7.1%). | unit: fraction | `0.043768` |
| `Z_SPREAD` | number | required | The zero-volatility spread over the benchmark curve, in basis points. | unit: bp | `17.1` |
| `MOD_DURATION` | number | required | The modified duration, in years. | unit: years | `4.5` |
| `RATING` | string | required | The bond's credit rating, S&P-style (BB-, A+ …). | — | `"AA+"` |
| `TERMS` | object | required | The bond's static terms: currency, coupon frequency, day count, issue date, amount issued, seniority, callable, CUSIP. | — | {…} |
| `TERMS.CURRENCY` | string | required | The bond's currency, ISO 4217. | one of `CAD`, `CHF`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `JPY`, `USD` | `"USD"` |
| `TERMS.COUPON_FREQUENCY` | string | required | How often the coupon is paid: Annual or Semi-annual. | one of `Annual`, `Semi-annual` | `"Semi-annual"` |
| `TERMS.DAY_COUNT` | string | required | The coupon's day-count convention (e.g. ACT/ACT). | — | `"ACT/ACT"` |
| `TERMS.ISSUE_DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The bond's issue date. | — | `"2021-02-15"` |
| `TERMS.AMOUNT_ISSUED` | integer | required | The face amount issued, in the bond's currency. | unit: bond currency | `2800000000` |
| `TERMS.SENIORITY` | string | required | The bond's ranking: Sovereign or Senior unsecured. | one of `Senior unsecured`, `Sovereign` | `"Sovereign"` |
| `TERMS.CALLABLE` | boolean | required | true when the issuer may redeem the bond early. | — | `false` |
| `TERMS.CUSIP` | string | optional (filled in 31% of `TERMS` entries) | The 9-character CUSIP, for US issues; null otherwise. | — | `"0UST03005"` |
| `COUPONS` | array of objects | required | The bond's next coupon payments, at most six, earliest first: one object per payment. | — | [5 objects] |
| `COUPONS[].DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The coupon's payment date. | — | `"2027-02-15"` |
| `COUPONS[].AMOUNT` | number | required | The coupon paid on that date per 100 of face value (the annual coupon divided by the payments a year). | unit: per 100 face | `1.91` |
| `HISTORY` | array of objects | required | The bond's daily price history, oldest first: one object per business day. | — | [30 objects] |
| `HISTORY[].DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | A business day of the price history, oldest first, ending at the record's date. | — | `"2026-05-27"` |
| `HISTORY[].PRICE` | number | required | The bond's clean price that day, per 100 of face. | unit: per 100 face | `98.968` |
| `ISSUER` | string | required | The issuer: an ISSUER_ID of the core pack's issuer kind (ISS-…). | pattern `^ISS-`; links to `issuer` | `"ISS-UST"` |
| `BENCHMARK_CURVE` | string | required | The government curve the bond is spread over: a CURVE_ID of the market-data pack's ir-curve kind (CRV-<ccy>-GOVT). | pattern `^CRV-`; links to `ir-curve` | `"CRV-USD-GOVT"` |

## Fields in other rows

None: all 1,920 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `ISIN` per `business_date`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `ISIN`, `ISIN_CODE`, `ISSUER_NAME`, `COUPON`, `MATURITY`, `PRICE`, `YIELD`, `Z_SPREAD`, `MOD_DURATION`, `RATING`, `TERMS`, `COUPONS`, `HISTORY`, `ISSUER`, `BENCHMARK_CURVE` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Each day: the records new or changed that day (or all of them); Drishti keeps the rest from the day before.
- Unique: `ISIN` per business_date.
- `ISIN` matches `^BND-`.
